text:
Murkrow and the Nighttime Adventure | POKÉTOON Short
Returning home after losing his memory, Hiro is surprised when a Cyndaquil and an Aipom rush up to him. They seem to be his friends, but Hiro is confused because he doesn’t remember them... Carrying a handmade badge, he enters his bedroom—and a Murkrow is waiting outside the window. That night, as bits and pieces of his memory come rushing back, Hiro sets out to find the Murkrow, who happens to be wearing the same kind of badge as him...
